description: Custom Azure Content Understanding analyzer for inbound fax documents (referrals, orders, forms, invoices). Mixes extract/classify/generate field methods to demonstrate capabilities beyond classic OCR-based extraction.

fieldSchema.name: FaxDocumentFields
fieldSchema.description: Structured fields extracted or generated from an inbound fax document

SenderName.description: Name of the person who sent the fax, from the letterhead, signature, or transmission banner

SenderOrganization.description: Company, clinic, or organization name of the sender

SenderFaxNumber.description: Fax number of the sender, typically found in the transmission banner at the top of the page

SenderPhoneNumber.description: Callback phone number for the sender, if present in the document

RecipientName.description: Name of the intended recipient of the fax

RecipientFaxNumber.description: Fax number of the recipient, typically found in the transmission banner

DateSent.description: Date the fax was sent or the date printed on the document, whichever is most specific

PageCount.description: Total number of pages in the fax transmission, from the banner if present

DocumentType.description: Classification of the primary document type contained in the fax

Subject.description: Subject line or stated reason for the fax, if present

Summary.description: A 2-3 sentence plain-language summary of the fax content, written for a reviewer to quickly triage the document

ActionRequired.description: Whether the document explicitly requests an action, reply, signature, or follow-up from the recipient

ActionDescription.description: If ActionRequired is true, a short description of the action being requested; otherwise empty
